description.en:
Brings several characters, one after the other, back into the party with the important return presentation. For each character, the jingle J_07 plays, the system message "sysmes-back_party" is shown with the character's name filled in (CMND_MESSAGE_REPLACE_CHARA), then the character is added with AddParty. The next character waits until the jingle has finished.
The BGM is left playing: no fade and no extra wait.
It is a preset of AddParty_MessageEx(_add_num, _aParamID, _aPtLock, _aAvatarEnable, _aAvatarLock, _aLv, -1, -1, "J_07", 0, "sysmes-back_party").
Number of characters to add; the arrays below are read from index 0 to _add_num - 1.
Parameter IDs of the characters, e.g. ["para_cp0001", "para_cp0013"].
One level per character; -1 (or any value of 0 or less) keeps the current level.
